recipes.name: The Easiest Mac and Cheese (3 Ingredients)
instructions: In a 6-8 quart stock pot, bring the half and half and water to a boil and season with salt. Add the elbow macaroni and cook until al dente per package directions, about 7-9 minutes.
Turn off the heat and add in the shredded cheese, stirring to melt the cheese and coat the pasta. Check seasoning, add salt to taste if necessary, and enjoy.
